fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects a suspicious process spawning a Chromium based browser process with the 'load-extension' flag to start an instance with a custom extension
fields.name: Suspicious Chromium Browser Instance Executed With Custom Extension
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and ((src.process.image.path contains "\\cmd.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\cscript.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\mshta.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\powershell.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\pwsh.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\regsvr32.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\rundll32.exe" or src.process.image.path contains "\\wscript.exe") and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\brave.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\chrome.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\msedge.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\opera.exe" or tgt.process.image.path contains "\\vivaldi.exe") and tgt.process.cmdline contains "--load-extension="))
